summary: The candidate DOCX 0136 satisfies the I19-E26 genre as an operational original-evidence verification register rather than a results report. The exact official indicator-19 reference-example sentence is reproduced verbatim (TABLE 5) and explicitly framed as a listed reference type, not an association result (Section 2; TABLE 2). Identity fields bind DOCX 0136 ↔ I19-E26 ↔ project index 150 while keeping the printed checkbox serial UNKNOWN (TABLE 1, TABLE 6). Three separate verification paths separate existence/identity, association role, and outcome (Section 3, TABLE 9), matched by status machinery (TABLE 12), hold/reject conditions (Sections 5–7, TABLES 10, 13), field dictionary (TABLE 21), blank working tables T1–T6 (TABLES 22–26), retrieval drill (Section 12, TABLE 31), and a complete T6 replacement register for every synthetic field (TABLES 28–29). All three SAMPLE walkthroughs use synthetic labels, no attached sources, no hashes, and NOT FOR EXTERNAL USE wording. Neighbor lanes 0135/I19-E25, 0137/I19-E27, 0133/I19-E22, 0134/I19-E23 are explicitly routed out (TABLE 7, TABLE 8). No self-score, no fabricated source, no invented governance rules; unknowns and non-association authority limits are marked rather than invented (TABLE 4, TABLE 14, TABLE 32). No blocking or major semantic defect found; findings are minor only.

findings.locator: TABLE 21 (T1 欄位字典) vs TABLE 4 (期限與權限)

findings.why_it_matters: A staff member filling a REAL row might not record a retention/review date unless the association later issues its own rules, so the field could be silently omitted rather than explicitly marked UNKNOWN.

sample_real_boundary: Readily enforced and unmistakable. Page-level marks precede each walkthrough (TABLES 15, 17, 19: SYNTHETIC 操作練，非原始點協會…紀錄；不得當作 REAL 或對外引用); every T1 sample row closes with 可對外文字 NOT FOR EXTERNAL USE and an explicit boundary sentence (e.g., 此 SAMPLE 不可作為活動曾舉辦、協會曾參與或有成效之主張); no real organizer/school/issuer/recipient names, no fabricated certificates, letters, MOUs, signatures, hashes, box numbers, or beneficiary counts anywhere; TABLE 22 confirms no REAL case rows exist; TABLE 32 states REAL evidence UNKNOWN and Human acceptance NOT GRANTED; TABLES 28–29 register each synthetic field with its replacement source and TABLE 30 forbids direct copy of SAMPLE values into REAL rows.
negative_neighbor_distinction: Effective and explicit. TABLE 7 gives a dedicated routing row for each neighbor: market/customer-value analysis must not be imported from 0135 (I19-E25); media reports can only be locators/corroboration, never the underlying original, and belong to 0137 (I19-E27), matching the packet's rule that a press clipping does not replace the award/participation/partnership original; training class/person-time statistics (0133/I19-E22) and member/dues ledgers (0134/I19-E23) are barred from being counted as social impact. TABLE 8 operationalizes double-count prevention via the shared event_project_key with one original source stored once and per-document citation scopes. The extract from project index 149/150/151 confirms index 150 (not 151 media) is the correct planning anchor, and the candidate's title/content match the 公益／表揚／產學／研發社會影響：原件與來源 lane. The title-blind check (公益活動、獎項與學校合作原件驗證登錄表 as an intake/verification tool) fits the requirement without drifting into the 0135 market-value genre or the 0137 media-index genre.
quantitative_claims: The candidate makes no association performance numbers and correctly blocks them. Outcome fields mandate unit, period, numerator, denominator, and source per claim (TABLE 3 step 05; TABLE 21 row 角色與結果), forbid inferring impact or causation from attendance/partnership/award (TABLE 13), keep the synthetic school case's use context, beneficiaries, and results UNKNOWN with no ratio or causal narrative (Section 7 本案例不計算效益), and route any future numeric data through per-item registration of unit/molecular/denominator/dedup/original source. The only numerals present are structural identifiers (DOCX 0136, I19-E26, index 150, table numbering) and synthetic sample labels (SAMPLE_DATE=2026-06-15, 2026-05-20, SAMPLE_PERIOD 2026-04-01 至 2026-09-30), which are internally consistent between the walkthroughs (TABLES 16/18/20) and the T6 replacement register (TABLES 28–29). No cross-document inconsistency detected within the candidate text.
operational_usability: High for the source-preparation register genre. A staff member with zero verified sources can: (1) intake one claim per row with pause/refuse triggers (TABLE 3 step 01); (2) preserve only actually received files with real SHA-256 and no placeholder artifacts (TABLE 3 step 02; 空白作業表 notes); (3) run class-specific three-layer checks (TABLE 9) with UNKNOWN/reject conditions per class (TABLE 10); (4) assign one of six statuses with defined wording and handling (TABLE 12), including escalation path via HOLD_PRIVACY/REJECTED and correction history preservation (Section 10); (5) file evidence in T2 custody rows (TABLE 23), verify entry-by-entry in T3 (TABLE 24), track gaps in T4 (TABLE 25), and bind external wording to sources in T5 (TABLE 26 with TABLE 27 wording control); (6) run a six-step, by-another-person-repeatable retrieval drill (TABLE 31) plus a handoff self-check (Section 12). The design does not invent authority, deadlines, or signatures—each requires a citing formal source or stays UNKNOWN (TABLE 4, TABLE 14, TABLE 21 后續與決定 row)—which keeps the tool compliant with an association whose internal rules are not yet confirmed to the candidate.
limitations: This is an independent text-semantic review of the packet's extracted candidate text bound to the stated exact SHA; visual/rendered-page QA, technical QA, and Association/Human acceptance are separate and out of scope. Verdict is reviewer opinion, not formal acceptance.
